__1 Shade, shadow (changed at the end of Tat. comp. into छायम् when बाहुल्य or thickness of shade is meant; e. g. इक्षुच्छायनिषादिन्यः [[
]]; 6. 46; अनुभवति हि मूर्ध्ना पादपस्तीव्रमुष्णं शमयति परितापं छायया संश्रितानाम् [[Ś. 5. 7]]; [[

.]] 
__2 A reflected image, a reflection; छाया न मूर्छति मलोपहतप्रसादे शुद्धे तु दर्पणतले सुलभावकाशा [[Ś. 7. 32.]] 
__3 Resemblance, likeness; क्षित्यादीनामिहार्थानां छाया न कतमापि हि [[

.]] 
__4 A shadowy fancy, hallucination; असता छाययोक्ताय सदाभासाय ते नमः [[

.]] 
__5 Blending of colours. 
__6 Lustre, light; भ्रष्टश्च स्वरयोगो मे छाया चापगता मम [[

.]] 
__8 Colour of the face, complexion; केवलं लावण्यमयी छाया त्वां न मुञ्चति [[Ś. 3]]; मेघैरन्तरितः प्रिये तव मुखच्छायानुकारी शशी [[S. D.]]; [[

]], 104. 
__10 Protection. 
__11 A row, line. 
__12 Darkness; (metaphorically) Avidyā; छायातपौ यत्र न गृध्रपक्षौ [[

.]] 
__13 A bribe. 
__14 N. of Durgā. 
__15 The [Page0720-1] shadow of a gnomon as indicating the sun's position. 
__16 The Sun. 
__17 Nightmare. 
__18 N. of a wife of the sun (she was but a shadow or likeness of संज्ञा, the wife of the sun; consequently when संज्ञा went to her father's house without the knowledge of her husband, she put छाया in her own place. छाया bore to the sun three children:-- two sons Sāvarṇi and Śani, and one daughter Tapanī). 
__19 A Sanskrit version of a Prākṛt text. 
__20 The Ganges; [[L. D. B.]] 
__21 Method; [[L. D. B.]] 
__22 A servant's chit; [[L. D. B.]]

-आत्मन् m. a reflected image or form. 
-करः the bearer of an umbrella.
